decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core physical-music catalog that was publicly launched earlier, management is still inclined to justify the original decision and keep it unless weak demand has clearly persisted beyond what can be blamed on niche-market timing.

Because this illustrated release series is a more visible, multi-model line tied to the firm's stated broadening strategy, sunk costs and the need to justify a public commitment make continued support especially likely.

This jazz vinyl reissue fits the firm's reissue expertise and genre-expansion path, so management would tend to persist and attribute any underperformance to the long-tail nature of specialist physical releases rather than abandon it quickly.

A multi-disc box set is resource-intensive and highly visible but also close to the firm's collector-oriented offer, which encourages management to continue backing it rather than concede that the investment was misplaced.

Although it is close to the established offer, this compilation CD appears to have involved the least visible commitment and is therefore the easiest for management to discontinue once attention shifts to stronger catalog lines and new projects.
